events.title: Patch Notes: Crows & Polish
events.summary: Thanks to everyone playing and sending feedback! This update adds a bit more life to the valley. New Added crows. Flocks now appear in the valley during the day and can linger into the night Added dust particles for falling trees on impact Tweaks Improved the hint lights shown for tools like the pliers, wrench and crowbar Improved The Hollow's behavior If you run into anything else, let me know in the discussions or leave a bug report. It helps a lot, since I'm making this game solo. Stay close

events.title: Patch Notes: Bug Fixes & Polish
events.summary: Thanks to everyone playing and sending feedback! This update squashes a bunch of bugs that you found. Fixes Fixed getting stuck after standing up inside the tent when using hold-to-crouch Fixed the end screen and black screen overlapping and fighting each other Fixed the electrical box collision size Fixed a small flicker of light right before waking up after being caught Fixed The Hollow being seen moving at the very edge of your screen. If you can see it, it stays still Tweaks You now respawn

events.title: Demo update: first-night freeze fixed
events.summary: Hey everyone! Thanks to everyone who tried The Kept Fire demo and sent feedback. A new demo build is live with these changes: - Fixed a bug where players got frozen after passing the first night. If you ran into the freeze before, please give the demo another try. Steam should update it automatically; if it doesn't, restart Steam. I'd love to hear what you think. There's a short feedback form at the end of the demo, and you can wishlist the game to follow along and get notified at launch. Thank
